title: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc - proposed acquisition of Life Technologies Corporation

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC timeline suspended and former proposed decision date of 14 November 2013 delayed to allow the merger parties to provide additional information to the ACCC.
ACCC received further information from the merger parties. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to a section 87B undertaking accepted by ACCC.

body_sections.Summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc proposed to acquire all of the shares of  Life Technologies Corporation.
